status: Unexecuted source-only prototype and service contract, not Source integration or mechanical/audio qualification.
purpose: One unchanged speaking geometry with indefinite event-relative control support and explicitly owned actual arrival, preserving incoming field and active contact energy. No invented fit knobs.

ownership.PhysicalStringOwner: Persistent full two-axis q/v, basis/mass/Omega/alpha/B, pickup/electrical histories and lifetime E+sumU-W+D. This prototype never creates, reads, resets, rescales, reseeds or mutates those fields. Tokens are caller evidence labels, not computed field hashes or proof.

ownership.ContactInstance: Actual eventboundary/startOrder, independently supplied first Contact-rendered engineclock (or explicitunownedNone for control-only), attachment y/v, DF-II-Tstoredstate/R and three planned knots, active/U and last owner endpoint evidence.
ownership.Actuator: State-conditioned support trajectory remains the alreadydeclared hypothesis; it is NOT measured hand motion and may supply/extract external work. Passive spring does not mean zero-actuatorwork.
ownership.LogicalIntent: MIDI owners, NoteOff/CC64/MPE/pendingcancel remain the existing engine scheduler responsibility. Logical phase/Voice.active is never proof mechanicalU vanished.

clock_and_sides.coordinate: Absolute boundary ticks and local integer/Fraction differences; subtract integer eventorigin before any float conversion. Do not infer Contact boundary from MIDI or first renderedclock.
clock_and_sides.adapter: Immediate/deferred production order must be mapped and separately qualified from exact source/test corpus. Deferred path renders pending sample first then commits; no universal +/-1 assumption. None first-renderedclock blocks any physical-clock qualification claim.
clock_and_sides.interval: Qualified mechanical owner supplies [t0,t1] endpoints; support owner supplies z0/z1, right-side policy at endpoint. Existing field-force/work/D/construction checks remain external prerequisites.
clock_and_sides.press: Original polynomial with duration=pressframes/96000, matching attachmentposition/velocity and y0+D/zero velocity at Release. Left Release uses press including its one-sided acceleration.
clock_and_sides.withdrawal: Same source PWL knots; right Release uses first withdrawal interval. Both sides of each velocity jump retained; zdd=0 is each interval/one-sided convention, not a globally smooth acceleration.
clock_and_sides.old_terminal: Original finitecrop has NO right interval at final knot. New postcrop support is a declared continuation, never old-reference evidence.

controller_definition.recurrence: output=beta*p[j]+storedstate; storedstate=a*output; R=R+output; z=y_attach+D-2*D*R. Exactly written operation order; no FMA/compiledlfilter bitidentity assumed.
controller_definition.input: Full original normalized-by-owner storedpulse, then indefinitely exactzeroinput; no repeatedpulse, tail renormalization, Rclipping, cutoff, arbitrarytimeout or forceddetach.
controller_definition.mathematical_limit: For storedcoefficients in exact-real recurrence Rinf=beta/(1-a_real)*sum(storedpulse), not necessarily1. zinf=y_attach+D-2D*Rinf, only approximatelyy_attach-D when massapproximately1. FloatingR can stall.
controller_definition.bounded_state: Three-knot cache plus filterstate/R, not cropallocatedarrays. One planned future knot supplies known actuator slope; no future field/audio read. Arbitrary backward ODE trial queries outside cache explicitly unsupported, never reset/replay active physics.

lifecycle.attach: Only actualarrival and fixedgeometry snapshot. No existing active contact may be overwritten: positiveU, zeroU-unretired and staleendpoint each explicitUNRESOLVED. No queue/delay/automaticretry/delete.
lifecycle.ordering: Strict (actualboundary,startOrder) ownership; rejected busy event consumed as explicitunsupported event, no silently delayed replay. Geometry changes unsupported.
lifecycle.retire: Only actual current endpoint gather/storagetokens plus t>=Release, rightdelta<=0/rightrelativev<=0 and exactU==0. Remove0storage only, unchangedq/v and lifetimeledger. Never use legacyphase/quietness/threshold as substitute.
lifecycle.no_detach_guarantee: Strongring-to-softstroke with positivey_attach>D, other incomingphases, D0 can remain active indefinitely. Fresh-from-rest retirement is no proof for arbitraryphase. Busy remains unresolved; no inventedextra lifttail.

equivalence_limits.real: Time translation and recurrence/press algebra are declared mathematical identities to be checked separately by induction/descriptor formulas.
equivalence_limits.binary: Compare actual ownedzero-origin prefix bits separately from actualabsolute-time reference and newlocalcontroller. Old(t-contact)/duration, SciPycompiledDFII/FMA, cumsum and interpolation subtraction may differ; never hide with a new tolerance or claim allabsoluteorigins bitidentity.
equivalence_limits.qualification: Exact raw-bit equality is evidence only for testedroute/fields. Rawdifferences/unavailable sides retained. No physicalaccuracy/naturalness/RT or new integration rail selected.

deferred_physics.condition: Whole96E mechanics must qualify first; controller-only gate can be reviewed/executed independently without physics outcomes.
deferred_physics.required: Persistent samegeometry incomingnonzeroq/v including phases/signs/strong→weak/D0, actualactiveU, lifetimework/D/native/appliedGram/gather/force rails and first/refined reference/event gates unchanged. Source input/observer/electrical history continuous.
deferred_physics.overlap_and_fret: No activeport retarget or multiport policy chosen. Fret changes/bend/modalbasis transport/newfinger ports and J>=3 remain unresolved separate mechanisms.

runtime_and_callback_limits.Python: Prototype allocates Python objects/Fraction/deque/dataclasses. No RT/fixed-array/host integration qualification.
runtime_and_callback_limits.backwardODE: Three-knot mutable cursor is not a general immutable backwardtrial ODE callback. Future independent reference must use a separately owned immutable trajectory callback or explicit controller cursor clone; never silent replay/reset of active mechanical state.
runtime_and_callback_limits.state: Current prototype has no field/solver/native integration. 96k eventboundary bookkeeping and standalone Fraction-time controller queries are distinct from a future finer-grid mechanical/reference event dispatcher.
